title: Citadel × Society Realignment
purpose: Resolve the tension between maximal authority integrity and effectively unbounded recursive growth without weakening either into a vague compromise.

conflicts.A: One minimal authority root should decide lawful transitions.
conflicts.B: Execution must distribute horizontally across many independent cases/workers.
conflicts.resolution: Centralize authority rules, not execution. Replicate stateless workers and case runtimes; every authority-bearing result returns to a deterministic receipt verifier.

conflicts.A: Scopes must not leak across cases.
conflicts.B: Caching/reuse is critical for large-scale efficiency.
conflicts.resolution: Reuse only content-addressed artifacts whose scope/compatibility predicate is satisfied; cache hits produce reuse receipts.

conflicts.B: Unlimited full traces become physically expensive.
conflicts.resolution: Keep immutable authority roots/receipts permanently according to policy; compact disposable intermediate work into content-addressed summaries and retention classes.

conflicts.B: One broken branch should not stop the society.
conflicts.resolution: Fail closed locally for the affected authority action while siblings continue; failure becomes a typed receipt and may trigger alternate workers/routes.

conflicts.A: Synthetic consensus must not become owner truth.
conflicts.B: Large solver societies need automated convergence.
conflicts.resolution: Maintain separate owner, solver and verification confidence channels. Solver consensus can select provisional design paths under policy but cannot fabricate owner evidence.
Every case carries a hierarchical budget envelope. Children receive sub-budgets. Budgets are configurable and raiseable, but recursion cannot create resources ex nihilo.

synthesisRules: Authority is narrow and deterministic; intelligence is wide and replaceable.
Scale occurs outside the kernel; trust returns through receipts.
Every child is powerful inside scope and powerless outside it.
Every budget delegation is explicit and conserved.
Every confidence value states its channel.
Every production promotion requires verification and explicit law-version advancement.
Every reusable result declares the exact scope in which reuse is valid.
outcome: A law small enough to audit, a fabric large enough to expand arbitrarily, and a receipt/capability boundary that lets the two coexist.
